name: Digivated Membership
custom_summary: Unlimited project uploads that go live instantly, plus the full UI/UX Prompt Packet and every member-only guide. $5 once.
description:
One membership. Full access to Digivated.

Digivated Membership is a $5 USD one-time purchase. There are no recurring charges or automatic renewals.

Unlimited project uploads, live instantly

Put as many projects on Digivated as you like. Each one goes live the moment you publish it, with no review queue and no badge required, and shows the Member mark. Projects must follow the listing rules; traffic, engagement, and sales are not guaranteed.

Full UI/UX Prompt Packet

Membership includes all 75 prompts, the complete prompt builder, eight workflows, eight checklists, examples, and learning material. You do not need to buy the Prompt Packet separately.

Every member guide

Membership includes the full member-only carousel library and references on Digivated.

How to use it

Buy with the same email as your Digivated account. Then open https://digivated.com/new-launch and press “I’ve paid, check again”; your account switches to unlimited uploads. To unlock the Prompt Packet and member guides on any browser, verify at https://digivated.com/membership#member-sign-in with your Gumroad receipt email or license key. You can also enter your Membership license key at https://digivated.com/access. Keep your receipt and license key private.

Every Digivated account can put one project on the site for free. Public project discovery, News and free samples remain free for everyone.

Checkout shows applicable taxes and purchase terms.
